sahneler.metin: In a snowstorm, a jet struck a bridge and plunged into the frozen Potomac.
Cars on the bridge were crushed, and most people aboard were killed.
The crew thought they had full take-off power.
Engine anti-ice was off, and ice had blocked the pressure probes.
The gauges read high while the engines made less thrust.
With snow on the wings too, the jet couldn't climb.
Winter de-icing and take-off procedures were overhauled.

aciklama:
Air Florida 90 crashed into a bridge and the frozen Potomac River. The cause: engine anti-ice left off, so iced pressure probes gave false thrust readings, plus ice on the wings.

#shorts #engineering #aviation

vaka.sonuc: crashed into a bridge and the frozen Potomac River
vaka.tetik: iced engine sensors showing more thrust than the engines made
vaka.mekanizma: engine anti-ice left off, so iced pressure probes gave false thrust readings, plus ice on the wings
vaka.ders: de-icing and winter take-off procedures were overhauled
vaka.yanilgi: The engines weren't failing. They were working normally, but the gauges said they were producing more power than they were.
vaka.tartisma: The first officer said something seemed wrong but the take-off continued. How should doubt be voiced in a cockpit?
